criteria.suggestion: Use a title such as fix(average): handle empty input and raise the batch limit.

criteria.description: The description includes a populated Summary section.
criteria.suggestion: Add a populated level-two Summary section.

criteria.description: The description explains why the changes are needed.
criteria.instructions: Does the PR description give a meaningful rationale for each substantive change visible in the diff? Restating what changed, generic statements such as 'make things better', or a Rationale heading alone do not satisfy this criterion.
criteria.suggestion: Explain the problem each substantive change solves and why this approach was chosen.

criteria.description: The description accurately covers all substantive changes in the diff.
criteria.instructions: Does the description accurately identify every substantive behavior or configuration change visible in all supplied file patches? A description mentioning only one of several substantive changes fails. Compare meaning with the diff, not just the presence of a Summary heading. Do not judge whether the code itself is correct.
criteria.suggestion: Describe every substantive change visible in the supplied patches.

criteria.description: The supplied review addresses all substantive changes in the PR.
criteria.instructions: Does the separately supplied review text address each substantive change visible in every supplied patch, including its implications or relevant edge cases? A generic approval, a repetition of the PR title, or a review addressing only one change fails. Missing evidence or ambiguous references do not establish coverage. Assess coverage, not whether the review proves the code correct.
criteria.suggestion: Extend the review to address each changed behavior and relevant edge cases.

criteria.description: The description records relevant validation for the changes.
criteria.instructions: Does the PR description explain relevant testing or a specific reason testing is not applicable for the substantive changes in the diff? A Testing heading, 'tests pass', or 'not discussed' alone is insufficient. Assess the explanation; do not invent or claim verification of test execution.
criteria.suggestion: Describe validation for empty input, ordinary averages, and the changed batch-size boundary.
